SELECT COUNT(*) FROM MARKETING_LEAD_INFO l JOIN MARKETING_CUSTOMER_INFO c ON c.id = l.cust_id AND c.record_status = 'ACTIVE' WHERE l.record_status = 'ACTIVE' AND l.lead_status = 'APPROVED' AND l.distribution_mode = 'PUBLIC' AND l.pool_status = 'AVAILABLE' AND c.ownership_status = 'UNASSIGNED' AND c.main_manager_id IS NULL AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM MARKETING_CUSTOMER_CLAIM cc WHERE cc.source_lead_id = l.id AND cc.claimed_by = #{empId} AND cc.claim_status = 'CLAIMED' )
AND (c.cust_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR c.cust_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR c.unified_credit_code LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR l.lead_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM MARKETING_LEAD_INFO l JOIN MARKETING_CUSTOMER_INFO c ON c.id = l.cust_id AND c.record_status = 'ACTIVE' WHERE l.id = #{leadId} AND l.record_status = 'ACTIVE' AND l.lead_status = 'APPROVED' AND l.distribution_mode = 'PUBLIC' AND l.pool_status = 'AVAILABLE' AND c.ownership_status = 'UNASSIGNED' AND c.main_manager_id IS NULL AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM MARKETING_CUSTOMER_CLAIM cc WHERE cc.source_lead_id = l.id AND cc.claimed_by = #{empId} AND cc.claim_status = 'CLAIMED' )

SELECT CAST(cc.id AS CHAR) AS claim_id, CAST(cc.cust_id AS CHAR) AS cust_id, CAST(cc.source_lead_id AS CHAR) AS source_lead_id, l.lead_no, c.cust_no, c.cust_name, c.unified_credit_code, c.contact_person, c.contact_mobile, c.industry, c.customer_type, l.entry_org_id AS owner_org_id, cc.org_id, cc.maintainer_emp_id, cc.claim_time, cc.claim_status, cc.cancel_reason, c.last_touch_time, l.lead_status, l.distribution_mode, 'CLAIM' AS source_type, l.distribution_mode AS allocation_source, c.legal_representative, c.registered_capital, c.registered_address, c.business_address, c.business_scope, c.group_type, c.group_name, c.enterprise_type, c.is_keystone, c.is_account_opened, c.touch_restricted, c.credit_amount, c.credit_exposure_amount, c.customer_desc, CAST(mtt.id AS CHAR) AS latest_task_id, mtt.task_no AS latest_task_no, mtt.task_status AS latest_task_status, mtt.sla_status AS latest_sla_status FROM MARKETING_CUSTOMER_CLAIM cc JOIN MARKETING_CUSTOMER_INFO c ON c.id = cc.cust_id AND c.record_status = 'ACTIVE' JOIN MARKETING_LEAD_INFO l ON l.id = cc.source_lead_id AND l.record_status = 'ACTIVE' LEFT JOIN MARKETING_TOUCH_TASK mtt ON mtt.id = ( SELECT mtt2.id FROM MARKETING_TOUCH_TASK mtt2 WHERE mtt2.source_type = 'CLAIM' AND ( mtt2.source_biz_id = cc.id OR ( mtt2.source_biz_id IS NULL AND mtt2.cust_id = cc.cust_id AND (mtt2.assignee_emp_id = cc.claimed_by OR mtt2.assignee_emp_id = cc.maintainer_emp_id) ) ) ORDER BY CASE WHEN mtt2.source_biz_id = cc.id THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, mtt2.created_time DESC, mtt2.id DESC LIMIT 1 ) WHERE (cc.claimed_by = #{empId} OR cc.maintainer_emp_id = #{empId}) AND cc.claim_status IN ('CLAIMED', 'CANCELLED')
AND c.last_touch_time IS NULL AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM MARKETING_TOUCH_TASK target_touched_task WHERE target_touched_task.source_type = 'CLAIM' AND ( target_touched_task.source_biz_id = cc.id OR ( target_touched_task.source_biz_id IS NULL AND target_touched_task.cust_id = cc.cust_id AND (target_touched_task.assignee_emp_id = cc.claimed_by OR target_touched_task.assignee_emp_id = cc.maintainer_emp_id) ) ) AND target_touched_task.task_status IN ('IN_PROGRESS', 'SUCCESS') )
AND (c.last_touch_time IS NOT NULL OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM MARKETING_TOUCH_TASK target_touched_task WHERE target_touched_task.source_type = 'CLAIM' AND ( target_touched_task.source_biz_id = cc.id OR ( target_touched_task.source_biz_id IS NULL AND target_touched_task.cust_id = cc.cust_id AND (target_touched_task.assignee_emp_id = cc.claimed_by OR target_touched_task.assignee_emp_id = cc.maintainer_emp_id) ) ) AND target_touched_task.task_status IN ('IN_PROGRESS', 'SUCCESS') ))
AND (c.cust_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR c.cust_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR c.unified_credit_code LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR l.lead_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
AND (l.distribution_mode = #{sourceType} OR #{sourceType} = 'CLAIM')
ORDER BY cc.claim_time DESC, cc.id DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{limit}

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM MARKETING_CUSTOMER_CLAIM cc JOIN MARKETING_CUSTOMER_INFO c ON c.id = cc.cust_id AND c.record_status = 'ACTIVE' JOIN MARKETING_LEAD_INFO l ON l.id = cc.source_lead_id AND l.record_status = 'ACTIVE' WHERE (cc.claimed_by = #{empId} OR cc.maintainer_emp_id = #{empId}) AND cc.claim_status IN ('CLAIMED', 'CANCELLED')
AND c.last_touch_time IS NULL AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM MARKETING_TOUCH_TASK target_touched_task WHERE target_touched_task.source_type = 'CLAIM' AND ( target_touched_task.source_biz_id = cc.id OR ( target_touched_task.source_biz_id IS NULL AND target_touched_task.cust_id = cc.cust_id AND (target_touched_task.assignee_emp_id = cc.claimed_by OR target_touched_task.assignee_emp_id = cc.maintainer_emp_id) ) ) AND target_touched_task.task_status IN ('IN_PROGRESS', 'SUCCESS') )
AND (c.last_touch_time IS NOT NULL OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM MARKETING_TOUCH_TASK target_touched_task WHERE target_touched_task.source_type = 'CLAIM' AND ( target_touched_task.source_biz_id = cc.id OR ( target_touched_task.source_biz_id IS NULL AND target_touched_task.cust_id = cc.cust_id AND (target_touched_task.assignee_emp_id = cc.claimed_by OR target_touched_task.assignee_emp_id = cc.maintainer_emp_id) ) ) AND target_touched_task.task_status IN ('IN_PROGRESS', 'SUCCESS') ))
AND (c.cust_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR c.cust_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR c.unified_credit_code LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR l.lead_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
AND (l.distribution_mode = #{sourceType} OR #{sourceType} = 'CLAIM')

SELECT id, cust_id, source_lead_id, org_id, claimed_by, maintainer_emp_id, claim_status, claim_time, cancel_time, cancel_reason, created_by, created_time, updated_by, updated_time, lock_version FROM MARKETING_CUSTOMER_CLAIM WHERE source_lead_id = #{sourceLeadId} AND claimed_by = #{claimedBy} AND claim_status = 'CLAIMED' ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM MARKETING_CUSTOMER_CLAIM WHERE cust_id = #{custId} AND (claimed_by = #{empId} OR maintainer_emp_id = #{empId}) AND claim_status = 'CLAIMED'
